I am a tenured [Assistant Professor of Norwegian](https://www.oslomet.no/en/about/employee/eiten9710/) at the Department of Early Childhood Education (BLU), OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan University, and a Guest Researcher of Linguistics at the Department of Linguistics and Scandinavian Studies (ILN), University of Oslo (UiO).

<!-- TODO (Eirik): confirm PhD status and wording. -->
My PhD project at UiO explores prosodic variation in Norwegian verb–particle constructions and is connected to the RCN-funded project [Variation and Change in the Scandinavian Verb Phrase](https://www.hf.uio.no/iln/english/research/projects/variation-and-change-in-the-scandinavian-verb-phra/).

## Research interests

- Child language and language acquisition
- Clinical linguistics
- Phonetics, phonology and prosody
- Multilingualism
- Scandinavian languages and dialectology
- Psycholinguistics
- Corpus linguistics
